name: hide
_design_note: F1-20 medium-light. AC 2 (vs leather/padded's 1) earns its weight: the early heavy option, same AC as studded leather but available sooner. Takes a crushing blow better.
lore_template: A wrap of thick {material_name}, lashed at the shoulders with cord. It is heavier than tanned leather and takes a crushing blow better. This is the oldest idea in armor: wear the skin of something tougher than the wearer.
